arguments.reason: The block was dropped when the weld released on the first post-grasp move (motion-layer gripper interpolation starts at the measured 0.66 > release threshold 0.6) and slid to (0.48, 0.35), outside the action space bounds (x<=0.45, y<=0.25); re-grasp is unreachable.
arguments.hindsight: On this harness, any move_to issued while holding the block starts its gripper interpolation at the measured ~0.66, which exceeds the 0.6 weld-release threshold, so the weld always drops on the first transport step. The oracle avoids this only because it bypasses the motion layer with constant gripper values. The agent path (any LLM, incl. K3 and me) cannot transport a welded block: K3 15/20 grasps then 0/20 is largely this harness artifact, not pure policy weakness.
